URL: https://abcnews.com/International/ukrainian-naval-drones-sank-russias-merkury-warship-libya/story?id=138369738
Published: 23 Nov 2026, 6:11 AM (ET), by David Brennan
(Extracted article content)
Zelenskyy confirmed Kyiv was behind the sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury, docked at the Libyan port of Benghazi on Sunday 22 November. Commissioned 2023; hit by several explosions.
Zelenskyy: "Our warriors deployed seven Ukrainian-made naval drones" ... "an exemplary Ukrainian operation." A Russian Ka-27 helicopter was destroyed along with the corvette.
Russian dry cargo vessel MV Angara, which he said was used to transport weapons, also hit.
SBU said both vessels were legitimate military targets; seven unmanned boats launched from a "mother ship"; attack coordinated with the military.
Vantor satellite image from 22 Nov shows the capsized corvette at a naval base in Benghazi.
Benghazi is capital of the Government of National Stability (GNS), eastern rival of the Tripoli-based GNU. GNS said the ship was hit by "unmanned vehicles", had docked for refuelling and supplies under a Russia-Benghazi cooperation agreement; joint investigation opened with Russia.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia had "taken note of Zelenskyy's statement".
